title: Social Services Legislation Amendment (Youth Employment) Bill 2015
short_title: Social Services Legislation Amendment (Youth Employment) Bill 2015

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would change rules for young people claiming certain welfare payments.
It would re-introduce some previously proposed budget measures with minor changes and add new ones.
The bill would, for example, exclude widow allowance recipients from a one-week waiting period and introduce a four-week waiting period for youth income support.
changes: Reintroduce modified versions of earlier budget measures related to youth employment.
Introduce additional amendments targeting young job seekers.
Exclude widow allowance claimants from a one-week ordinary waiting period.
Delay the start date for raising the age of eligibility for newstart and sickness allowances.
Create a four-week waiting period for youth income support.
Implement a measure to rapidly activate young job seekers.
summary.affected: Young job seekers and recipients of working age payments such as newstart and sickness allowances.
